mapping: Historical ITOT US stocks -> SPY US equity proxy only; not exact SPY constituents

feature_rules.concentration: Sector dollar-volume HHI; causal EMA10; lag10 second difference / prior126 derivative std; +/-0.5 deadband; positive acceleration increases SPY
feature_rules.breadth: Equal-count fraction above trailing126 adjusted-close mean; above55% bullish, below45% bearish
feature_rules.breadth_change: 20-session change in breadth using same cohort; +/-3 percentage point deadband
feature_rules.participation: Mean stock63-session momentum minus lagged holding-value weighted momentum; +/-2 percentage point deadband
feature_rules.signed_activity: 21-session sum(sign(stock adjusted daily return)*provider close*volume)/sum(close*volume); +/-5% deadband; activity proxy, not net flows
feature_rules.composite: Equal mean of five fixed ternary signals; no outcome-fitted weights
feature_rules.price_control: SPY63-session return +/-2%; same coverage gate and position sizing

coverage: One fixed complete-211-session stock subset within each dated cohort; excluded names retain snapshot value/name denominator. Whole-cohort >=95% value and >=70% names. Missing means no overlay, never exit.
timing: Prior-session close only; monthly existing SOTA rebalance at next open. Holdings available after modeled45calendar days;60day sensitivity. Actual historical vintages unknown.
allocation: Adjust existing positive SPY weight by score*15%, at most3pp; never create SPY if absent. Offset among other selected ETFs proportional to weights subject to3pp and45% bounds. Preserve gross/cash; no leverage.
inference: Information ratio = sqrt252*mean(daily challenger minus SOTA)/std(active); Sharpe uses zero cash hurdle, CNH accounting. Paired63/126-session block bootstrap,2000replicates; family-adjust max-t over all10 challengers. No untouched holdout: pre2023 tree fitted; post2023 baseline reused. ICs descriptive only, overlapping20/60/120 horizons.
